title: Build a spinner with pure CSS
why_it_matters: Loading states show up in every app, so a tiny reusable one is useful.
explanation: A circle with one colored border side, rotated forever, makes a spinner. @keyframes defines what changes over time. The animation property names it, sets the duration, the timing and how often it repeats.
try_it: Make the spinner bigger and change its speed to 2 seconds.
